Four comments

The Rose Of Rothes

Beautiful tune from the album ‘Tales of the North’, played together with ‘The Bell of Ardclach’. Both tunes are composed by Calum Steward himself.

↳ Posted by David J. Schwarz on November 9th, 2021.

Transposed

For those who like me prefer the D Flute/Whistle.
